_comment: The 'Power down when the fleet is quiet' job, in one place.
Two copies exist and neither may drift: the documented <pre data-job-example>
block in landing/docs.html, and the template chip in Settings -> Jobs that
pre-fills the editor with it. This fixture is what both are pinned to.
The two deliberate differences between the docs and the shipped preset are
pinned here too, because they are the safety rule, not an oversight:
the preset is DISABLED, and where the docs show a plausible script path the
preset ships an obvious blank. /opt/wks/power-down.sh exists on nobody's
machine; a preset that installed and armed it would schedule a command that
fails every five minutes at best, and powers down an unintended machine at
worst. work{spacer} powers nothing down itself. The script is the user's.
